descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Fly 16 amazing helicopters in mixed-reality or experience them at actual size!  

All models are finely detailed and scaled to 1/32.  Enjoy realistic flight physics tuned meticulously for MR play!

Choppers:
• Bell 47
• Robinson R44
• Bell 206 JetRanger
• Airbus AS350
• UH-1 "Huey" Iroquois
• UH-60 Black Hawk
• SB-1 Defiant
• CH-53 Sea Stallion
• CH-47 Chinook
• Mi-26 Halo
• AH-1 Cobra
• Mi-8 Hip
• MH-6 Little Bird
• Mi-24 Hind
• Ka-52 Alligator
• AH-64 Apache

Each chopper type has a timed "mission" activity:
• Crop spray: fly over crops to fertilize them!
• Firefight: fill your bucket and douse wildfire!
• Transport: deliver troops to the frontline!
• Heavy lift: hook up a heavy load and drop it at its destination!
• Attack: laser-designate targets to destroy them with guns and missiles!

Scan your room in Quest Environment setup and mission objects will be contained within it, otherwise a generic space is used.  Toggle wall-collision via radial menu (off by default).

Controls:
• Right Thumbstick: cyclic pitch+roll
• Left Thumbstick: collective & yaw
• Button A: next chopper (hold for menu)
• Button B: toggle mission (hold to toggle scale)
• Button X: fire gun
• Button Y: fire rocket/missile
• Trigger: positive collective
• Thumbstick button: negative collective
• Thumbstick button + Trigger activate SB-1 pusher-fan.
• Grip: grab/throw chopper

Check out "AR Planes" for more indoor flight!
